blocks.text: Yeh chapter 24 (Evolution) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai; short, long aur inquisitive sawalon ke model jawab (poore number wale) diye gaye hain. Farq wale sawalon ke jawab do column ki table mein hain. Kitab mein MCQs ki answer key nahi chhapi; jawab chapter ke text se nikale gaye hain.
Section 1: Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)

blocks.prompt:
1. Who developed a theory of natural selection essentially identical to Darwin's?
(Kis ne Darwin jaisi hi natural selection ki theory pesh ki?)
blocks.explanation: Alfred R. Wallace ne alag se Darwin jaisa hi evolution ka mechanism pesh kiya; dono theories 1858 mein Linnaean Society mein pesh hui (24.2.1).

blocks.prompt:
2. Which statement is incorrect?
(Kaun sa bayan ghalat hai?)

options.text: Homologous organs kaam mein mukhtalif lekin banawat mein ek jaise hain
Analogous organs kaam mein mukhtalif lekin banawat mein ek jaise hain
Insaan ka baazu, billi ki agli taang aur whale ka flipper analogous structures ki misaal hain
Chamgadar, parindon aur keeron ke par homologous structures ki misaal hain

blocks.explanation: Analogous organs kaam mein ek jaise lekin banawat mein mukhtalif hote hain, is liye (b) ghalat hai. Homologous organs banawat mein ek jaise aur kaam mein mukhtalif, is liye (a) durust hai (24.3.2).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sirf ek nahi, teen bayan ghalat hain: (b) analogous ki tareef ulti hai; (c) insaan ka baazu, billi ki taang aur whale ka flipper homologous hain, analogous nahi; (d) keeron ke par parindon aur chamgadar ke paron ke analogous hain, homologous nahi. Sirf (a) durust hai. Yahan (b) ko ghalat tareef ke taur par chuna gaya; ghaliban sawal "Kaun sa bayan durust hai?" tha, jis ka jawab (a) hai.

blocks.prompt:
3. Which of the following is an example of homologous organs?
(In mein se homologous organs ki misaal kaun si hai?)

options.text: Insaan aur whale ke agle aaza (forelimbs)
Machhli ka fin aur parinde ka par

blocks.explanation: Vertebrates ke agle aaza mein haddiyon ki tarteeb ek jaisi hai magar kaam mukhtalif (pakarna, tairna), is liye insaan ka baazu aur whale ka flipper homologous hain; parinde aur keere ke par analogous hain (24.3.2).

blocks.prompt:
4. According to the theory of natural selection, variations arise due to;
(Natural selection ki theory ke mutabiq variations (farq) kis wajah se paida hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Darwin ki theory mein genetic variations random mutations se paida hote hain aur virasati farq aulad mein jate hain (24.2.1). Use and disuse Lamarck ka khayal hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Options ke label (a), (b), (d), (d) chhape hain: "Selective breeding" par (d) chhapa hai, jabke (c) hona chahiye.

blocks.prompt:
5. Which condition is NOT required for Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium?
(Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium ke liye kaun si shart ZAROORI NAHI?)
blocks.explanation: Hardy-Weinberg equilibrium ke liye bari population, random mating, koi migration nahi, koi mutation nahi, aur tamam genotypes ki barabar baqa aur nasal kashi, yaani natural selection nahi, zaroori hain (24.2.2).

blocks.prompt:
6. Genetic drift is the change in gene frequency due to;
(Genetic drift gene frequency mein kis wajah se tabdeeli hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jab ittefaqi waqiat gene frequency badlein to yeh genetic drift (neutral selection) hai, jo chhoti populations mein zyada wazeh hai; migration se gene flow hota hai (24.2.2).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Options ke label (a), (b), (d), (d) chhape hain: "Emigration of individuals" par (d) chhapa hai, jabke (c) hona chahiye.

blocks.prompt:
7. Which of the following ideas is common to both Lamarckism and Darwinism?
(Kaun sa khayal Lamarckism aur Darwinism dono mein mushtarak hai?)

options.text: Mutations genetic variations ka zariya hain
Adaptations afraad ko mahol ki mushkilat ka saamna karne ke qabil banati hain
Aaza ke istemal aur na-istemal se acquired characters bante hain
Acquired characters agli naslon mein jate hain

blocks.explanation: Dono theories ke mutabiq jaandaar mahol ke mutabiq dhal jate hain (Lamarck: mahol ki tabdeeli ka behtar saamna; Darwin: adaptive traits baqa mein madad). (a) sirf Darwinism, (c) aur (d) sirf Lamarckism hain (24.2.1, 24.5).

blocks.prompt:
8. If a massive fire kills 90% of a population and survivors remain by luck. Such a change in allelic frequency will be called;
(Agar bari aag population ke 90% ko maar de aur baqi sirf qismat se bachen, to allele frequency ki is tabdeeli ko kya kahenge?)
blocks.explanation: Fitness ke bajaye ittefaq se bachna genetic drift hai, jaise chapter ki misaal mein aag se khargosh 100 se 10 reh gaye (24.2.2).

blocks.prompt:
9. Changes in gene frequency due to migration of individuals are called;
(Afraad ki migration (naql-e-makani) se gene frequency ki tabdeeli ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Afraad ke aane ya jane (migration) se gene frequency ki tabdeeli gene flow kehlati hai (24.2.2).

blocks.prompt:
10. What may be the best evidence for the endosymbiotic evolution of eukaryotes?
(Eukaryotes ke endosymbiotic evolution ka behtareen saboot kya ho sakta hai?)

options.text: Mitochondria mein gol (circular) DNA aur 70S ribosomes
Mitochondria ke gird ek tah wali membrane

blocks.explanation: Mitochondria ka apna gol DNA prokaryotic chromosome jaisa hai (aur prokaryotes jaise 70S ribosomes, jo Class XI mein parha), jo batata hai ke yeh nigle gaye prokaryotes se bane (24.4). Mitochondria ki do membranes hain, ek nahi.

blocks.prompt:
1. What is the concept of evolution?
Evolution ka tasawwur kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Evolution population ki genetic banawat (allele frequencies) mein naslon ke saath aahista tabdeeli hai, jis se nayi species ban sakti hain. Ibtidai khayal: jaandaar hamesha mojooda shakal mein nahi the, ek dam paida nahi hue, aur nichli se oonchi shakalon tak beshumar tabdeeliyon ka nateeja hain.

blocks.prompt:
2. How does homology provide an evidence of divergent evolution?
Homology divergent evolution ka saboot kaise deti hai?
blocks.explanation: Homologous structures banawat mein ek jaise magar kaam mein mukhtalif hote hain. In ka mushtarak naqsha batata hai ke jaandaron ka jadd-e-amjad (common ancestor) ek tha jo alag qismon mein bat gaya aur aaza mukhtalif kaamon mein lagaye, maslan vertebrates ke agle aaza jin mein haddiyan ek jaisi magar urne (chamgadar, parinda), tairne (whale), daurne (ghora) aur charhne (chhipkali) ke liye.

blocks.prompt:
3. How analogous organs represent convergent evolution?
Analogous organs convergent evolution ko kaise zahir karte hain?
blocks.explanation: Analogous organs kaam mein ek jaise magar banawat mein mukhtalif hote hain. Yeh alag alag ancestors se, ek jaise mahol mein rehne wale ghair mutaliq jaandaron mein bane jo ek hi hal tak pahunche, maslan parinde aur keere ke par, dono urne ke liye (urne ke liye chaurri chapti satah chahiye) magar homologous nahi.

blocks.prompt:
4. What is Hardy-Weinberg theorem?
Hardy-Weinberg theorem kya hai?
blocks.explanation: 1908 mein Godfrey Hardy aur Wilhelm Weinberg ne pesh kiya: bari, random mating wali population mein allele aur genotype frequencies nasal dar nasal ek jaisi rehti hain agar koi evolutionary force amal na kare (migration nahi, mutation nahi, tamam genotypes ki barabar baqa). Koi shart toot jaye to evolution hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
5. What are the factors that change allele frequencies?
Allele frequencies badalne wale factors kaun se hain?
blocks.explanation:
1. Genetic drift (neutral selection): ittefaqi tabdeeli, chhoti population mein zyada.
2. Gene flow: afraad ka population mein aana ya jana.
3. Mutation: naye alleles, variations ka zariya.
Is ke ilawa non-random mating, chhoti population aur natural selection (na-barabar baqa aur nasal kashi), yaani Hardy-Weinberg ki koi bhi shart tootna.

blocks.prompt:
6. Justify Lamarck as an early proponent of evolution.
Saabit karein ke Lamarck evolution ka ibtidai himayati tha.
blocks.explanation: Jean-Baptiste Lamarck (1744-1829) ne 1809 mein "Philosophie Zoologique" chhapi aur Darwin se pehle kaha ke jaandaar saada se paicheeda bante aur mahol ke mutabiq dhalte hain. Us ne mechanism bhi diya: aaza ka istemal/na-istemal aur acquired characters ki virasat (zarafe ki gardan). Mechanism ghalat tha, lekin us ne khul kar evolution ki himayat ki.

blocks.prompt:
7. Describe the drawbacks of Lamarckism.
Lamarckism ki khamiyan bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Acquired characters (zindagi mein haasil khususiyat) ki koi genetic bunyaad nahi, is liye agli nasl mein nahi jaatin.
2. Aaza jaandaar ki khwahish ya zaroorat se nahi badalte.
Lamarck ke daur mein mechanism ka saboot nahi tha; virasat ke mechanisms daryaft hone par Lamarckism ghalat saabit hua.

blocks.explanation: Lamarckism evolution ko use/disuse aur acquired characters ki virasat se samjhata hai; Darwinism variation aur natural selection se.

blocks.prompt:
1. Explain that evolution takes place due to variations in organisms and natural selection.
Wazeh karein ke evolution jaandaron mein variations aur natural selection ki wajah se hota hai.
blocks.explanation:
Evolution population ki allele frequencies mein naslon ke saath aahista tabdeeli hai. Yeh do cheezon ke mil kar kaam karne se hota hai:
1. Variations (farq): do afraad shaz-o-nadir hi bilkul ek jaise hote hain. Genetic variations random mutations se (aur, chapter se aage, jinsi tolid mein recombination se) paida hote hain. Yeh faidamand, nuqsandeh ya neutral ho sakte hain, aur virasati farq aulad mein jate hain.
2. Natural selection: jaandar wasail se kahin zyada bachche paida karte hain (sea star ek mausam mein taqreeban 10 lakh ande deti hai), is liye baqa ki jang hoti hai. Faidamand farq (adaptive traits) wale bachte aur nasal barhate hain; nuqsandeh farq wale mar jate ya nasal nahi barha pate.
Nateeja: adaptive traits agli nasl mein jate hain, population mein behtar khususiyat walon ka tanasub barhta hai, aur nuqsandeh traits kam ho kar khatam ho jate hain. Bohat si naslon mein jama shuda tabdeeliyan population ko itna badal sakti hain ke nayi species ban jaye.
Misaal: Galapagos finches; jin ki choonch apne jazeere ki khurak ke mutabiq thi woh bache aur nasal barhayi, is liye har jazeere par alag choonch wale finches hain.
Doosri misaal: antibiotic resistance; resistance wali mutation bacterium ko dawa se bachati hai aur us ki aulad yeh gene virasat mein leti hai.

blocks.prompt:
2. Explain the theory of natural selection as proposed by Darwin.
Darwin ki pesh karda natural selection ki theory bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Pas-e-manzar: Charles Darwin (1809-1882) 1831 mein HMS Beagle par naturalist ke tor par 5 saal ke safar par gaya. Us ne barsati jangalon mein bohat tanawwo (diversity), khatam shuda dio-hekal mammals ke fossils, aur Galapagos jazeeron par mukhtalif kachhwe (zeen jaisi aur gumbad jaisi shell) aur mukhtalif khurak ke mutabiq choonch wale finches dekhe. Nateeja: species badalti hain aur nayi species adaptations ke jama hone se banti hain. 1859 mein "On the Origin of Species" chhapi. Wallace ki theory bhi milti julti thi; dono 1858 mein Linnaean Society mein pesh hui.
Theory ka nichor:
1. Overproduction (zarurat se zyada paidaish): jaandaron ki tolid ki salahiyat asal se kahin zyada hai, maslan maada sea star har mausam taqreeban 10 lakh ande deti hai; sab bach jayen to samandar bhar jayen.
2. Variations: genetic farq random mutations se; do afraad shaz-o-nadir hi ek jaise; farq faidamand, nuqsandeh ya neutral; virasati farq aulad mein.
3. Struggle for survival (baqa ki jang): wasail se zyada bachche, is liye muqabla; nuqsandeh farq wale mar jate ya nasal nahi barhate, faidamand farq (adaptive traits) wale kamyab.
4. Adaptive traits ki virasat: faidamand traits agli naslon mein, nuqsandeh traits kam ho kar khatam.
Nateeja: bohat si naslon mein populations behtar dhal jati hain aur alag species ban sakti hain. 20vi sadi mein Darwinism genetics ke saath mil kar Neo-Darwinism bana.

blocks.prompt:
3. Explain how biogeography provides evidence for evolution.
Biogeography evolution ka saboot kaise deti hai?
blocks.explanation:
Biogeography paudon aur janwaron ki zameeni taqseem (geographic distribution) ka ilm hai. Yeh batati hai ke duniya ke mukhtalif hisson mein zindagi ki apni evolutionary tareekh hai:
1. Ek jaise groups bari rukawaton (samandar, pahar) se alag jagahon par rehte hain. Mushabihat mushtarak ancestor batati hai aur farq laakhon saal ke alag evolution ka nateeja hai. Misaal: African lion America ke mountain lion se bohat milta hai.
2. Geographical rukawaton se alag jaandar ek jaise mahol ke bawajood aksar bohat mukhtalif hote hain. Misaal: Australia aur Tasmania ke bohat se janwar kahin aur nahi milte; wahan kangaroo ki kai species bare herbivores hain.
3. Jazeeron par aksar kam magar munfarid (unique) species hoti hain, jazeere par basne aur phir evolution ki wajah se. Misaal: Galapagos ke finches aur kachhwe har jazeere par mukhtalif magar South America ki shakalon jaise.
Yeh patterns is tarah samajh aate hain ke jaandar asal jagah se phaile aur phir alag alag evolve hue, na ke har jagah alag paida kiye gaye.

blocks.prompt:
4. Describe the evidences of evolution that come from comparative anatomy.
Comparative anatomy se milne wale evolution ke saboot bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Comparative anatomy wale fossils aur zinda jaandaron ki banawat ka muqabla karte hain taake evolutionary rishte milen. Is se do qism ka evolution aur vestigial organs saamne aate hain:
1. Homologous structures aur divergent evolution: banawat ek jaisi, kaam mukhtalif (homology). In wale jaandaron ka mushtarak ancestor tha jo alag ho kar aaza ko mukhtalif kaamon mein lagane laga. Misaal: vertebrates ke agle aaza mein haddiyon ki ek jaisi tarteeb, magar urna (parinde, chamgadar), tairna (whale, dolphin), daurna (ghora), charhna (darakhti chhipkali) aur shaakhon par jhoolna.
2. Analogous structures aur convergent evolution: kaam ek jaisa, banawat mukhtalif. Alag ancestors wale jaandar ek jaise mahol mein ek jaise hal tak pahunche. Misaal: parinde aur keere ke par, dono urne ke liye, homologous nahi; urne ke liye chaurri chapti satah zaroori hai.
3. Vestigial organs (be-kaar baqiya aaza): kabhi kaam ke the, ab kamzor aur be-faida; tabdeeli ka wazeh saboot. Misaal: boa aur python mein pichhli taangon (pelvic) ki nanhi haddiyan; insaan mein (taqreeban 90) appendix (caecum ka baqiya), coccyx (dum ka baqiya), wisdom teeth (teesri daarh jo paude chabane ke kaam aati thi) aur kaan ke muscles.

blocks.prompt:
5. Differentiate between convergent and divergent evolution on the basis of inheritance of the homologous and analogous structures.
Homologous aur analogous structures ki virasat ki bunyaad par convergent aur divergent evolution mein farq karein.
blocks.explanation: Divergent evolution homologous structures se zahir hota hai jo mushtarak ancestor se virasat mein mile; convergent evolution analogous structures se, jo mushtarak ancestor se nahi mile balke ek hi kaam ke liye alag alag bane.

blocks.prompt:
6. Describe the evidences of evolution that come from molecular biology.
Molecular biology se milne wale evolution ke saboot bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Homologous biochemicals: jaise janwaron ke homologous structures hain, waise homologous biochemicals bhi. Banawat aur kaam genetic naqshe, DNA, par mabni hain jo tamam jaandaron mein hai; yeh khud mushtarak asal ki taraf ishara hai.
2. Milta julta DNA aur proteins: rishtedar janwaron ka DNA mushtarak ancestor se mila hua aur milta julta hai; DNA proteins ka code deta hai, is liye proteins bhi milte julte. Jitna qareebi rishta, utna kam farq.
3. Molecular dating: scientists mukhtalif jaandaron ke DNA aur proteins nikal kar jaanchte hain; farq gin kar aur mutation ki taqreeban mustaqil raftar maan kar andaza lagate hain ke do nasalein mushtarak ancestral molecule se kab alag hui.
4. Evolution samne hota hua: jaraseem mein antibiotic resistance. Resistance bacterial genes mein mutations se paida ho sakti hai; natural selection se bana resistance gene bacteria ki agli naslon mein jata hai, aur antibiotic ke samne population badal jati hai.

blocks.prompt:
7. Outline the steps of the evolution of the giraffe, as illustrated in Lamarckism.
Lamarckism ke mutabiq zarafe ke evolution ke marahil bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Zarafe ke ancestors ki gardan chhoti thi aur woh ghaas ya chhote paudon ke patte khate the.
2. Mahol badla aur chhote paude na rahe.
3. Kuch afraad oonche darakhton ke patte tak pahunchne ke liye gardan khainchne lage.
4. Musalsal istemal (use and disuse) se un ki gardan zindagi mein mazboot aur lambi ho gayi: acquired character.
5. Nasal barhane par yeh acquired character virasat mein gaya: bachche thori lambi gardan ke saath paida hue.
6. Bachchon ne bhi gardan khainchi aur woh aur lambi aur mazboot hui.
7. Bohat si naslon tak yahi hone se lambi gardan wala zarafa bana.
(Darwin ki wazahat: zarafon ki gardan mein pehle hi farq tha; lambi gardan walon ko zyada khurak mili, woh zyada bache aur nasal barhayi.)

blocks.prompt:
8. Describe the endosymbiont theory about the evolution of eukaryotes from prokaryotes.
Prokaryotes se eukaryotes ke evolution ke baare mein endosymbiont theory bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Pas-e-manzar: sab se pehle jaandar prokaryotes the (taqreeban 3.5 arab saal pehle); eukaryotes taqreeban 2 arab saal pehle prokaryotes se bane. Lynn Margulis ki Endosymbiotic Theory sab se zyada qabool shuda hai.
Theory:
1. Bare prokaryotes ne chhote prokaryotes ko nigal liya magar hazam nahi kiya; chhote andar reh kar organelles ban gaye.
2. Dono ka symbiotic (bahami faide ka) rishta bana.
3. Aerobic respiration karne wale chhote prokaryotes apne aur meezban (host) ke liye energy dete the aur mitochondria ban gaye.
4. Dhoop se khurak banane wale chhote cells khurak baantte the aur chloroplasts ban gaye.
5. Flagella shayad spirochetes jaise nigle gaye prokaryotes se bane.
6. Yeh taqatwar eukaryotic cells kai-cellular (multicellular), cells ki takhassus aur bare size tak pahunche, jis se janwaron, paudon aur fungi ka tanawwo bana.
Saboot:
1. Mitochondria aur chloroplasts prokaryotic cells ke size ke hain.
2. In ka apna DNA hai, prokaryotes jaisa gol (circular) chromosome.
3. Yeh prokaryotes ki tarah binary fission se taqseem hote hain (eukaryotic cells mitosis se).
4. In ki membranes prokaryotic membranes se zyada milti hain.
(Doosra khayal, Membrane Invagination Theory: cell membrane andar mur kar nucleus aur ER bani.)

blocks.prompt:
9. Describe the theory of inheritance of acquired characters, as proposed by Lamarck.
Lamarck ki pesh karda acquired characters ki virasat ki theory bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Jean-Baptiste Lamarck (1744-1829), French naturalist, ne 1809 mein "Philosophie Zoologique" (Zoological Philosophy) chhapi. Us ke mutabiq jaandar saada se paicheeda bane aur tabdeeli tab hoti hai jab woh mahol ke mutabiq dhalte hain. Mechanism ke do hisse:
1. Aaza ka istemal aur na-istemal: mahol badle to jaandar kuch aaza zyada aur kuch kam istemal karta hai. Zyada istemal wale aaza mazboot, na-istemal wale kamzor ho jate hain. Zindagi mein aisi tabdeeliyan "acquired characters" hain.
2. Acquired characters ki virasat: zindagi mein haasil khususiyat aulad mein jati hain; naslon tak jama ho kar jaandar ko mahol ka behtar saamna karne ke qabil banati hain.
Misaal: zarafe ki gardan, oonche darakhton tak pahunchne ke liye khainchi gayi, zindagi mein lambi hui aur aage gayi, yahan tak ke lambi gardan wala zarafa bana.
Khamiyan: acquired characters ki genetic bunyaad nahi, is liye virasat mein nahi jaate; aaza khwahish ya zaroorat se nahi badalte. Virasat ke mechanisms daryaft hone par Lamarckism ghalat saabit hua, magar Lamarck evolution ka ibtidai himayati mana jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
1. Interpret different homologous and analogous structures through observation in plants.
Paudon ke mushahide se mukhtalif homologous aur analogous structures ki tashreeh karein.
blocks.explanation:
Chapter ke khayalat paudon par bhi lagu hote hain (paudon ki misaalein chapter se aage hain):
Paudon mein homologous structures (asal ek, kaam mukhtalif), divergent evolution:
1. Badle hue patte: matar ki tendrils (charhna), cactus ke kaante (hifazat, paani ki bachat), piyaz ke gooday dar chhilke (zakhira) aur pitcher plant ka ghara (keere pakarna), sab patte hain.
2. Badle hue tane: aalu (zakhira), adrak (zakhira) aur bougainvillea ke kaante (hifazat), sab tane hain.
Paudon mein analogous structures (asal mukhtalif, kaam ek), convergent evolution:
1. Charhna: matar ki tendril (patta) aur angoor ki tendril (tana).
2. Hifazat: cactus ka kaanta (patta), bougainvillea ka kaanta (tana) aur gulab ka kaanta (satah ka ubhaar).
3. Zameen mein khurak ka zakhira: aalu (tana) aur shakarqandi ya gaajar (jarr).
Mushahida: dekhein structure kahan se nikalta hai (patte ki baghal mein kali = tana; us ke oopar kali = patta); asal ek = homologous, kaam ek magar asal alag = analogous.

blocks.prompt:
2. Hypothesize whether Lamarck was criticized in his day for advocating the ideas of evolution or for the mechanism he proposed.
Mafrooza (hypothesis) banayein: kya Lamarck ko apne daur mein evolution ki himayat par tanqeed ka nishana banaya gaya ya us ke pesh karda mechanism par?
blocks.explanation:
Hypothesis: Lamarck ko apne daur mein mechanism se zyada evolution (tabdeeli) ke khayal ki himayat par tanqeed ka saamna hua.
Chapter se dalail:
1. Us daur mein aksar scientists creationism ko maante the ke har qism alag paida ki gayi aur kabhi nahi badli; species ke badalne ki baat hi na-qabil-e-qabool thi.
2. Evolution ke kisi mechanism ki wazahat ka koi saboot maujood nahi tha aur genes ka ilm nahi tha, is liye us ka mechanism (use/disuse, acquired characters ki virasat) abhi test ya radd nahi ho sakta tha.
3. Chapter kehta hai ke scientists ne us ke tabdeeli ke khayalat qabool nahi kiye, aur us par mechanism se zyada evolution ki himayat par tanqeed hui.
4. Baad mein virasat ke mechanisms daryaft hone par us ka mechanism ghalat saabit hua (acquired characters ki genetic bunyaad nahi).
Hypothesis ko test karna: us ke ham-asr logon (maslan Cuvier, chapter se aage) ki tehreerein parh kar dekhein ke unhon ne species ke badalne ke khayal par hamla kiya ya use/disuse ki tafseel par.

blocks.prompt:
3. Justify, on the grounds that both Wallace's and Darwin's papers were published in the Journal of the proceedings of the Linnaean Society, why the theory was attributed to Darwin.
Jab Wallace aur Darwin dono ke papers Linnaean Society ke journal mein chhape, to wazeh karein ke theory Darwin se kyun mansoob hui.
blocks.explanation:
1. Darwin is khayal par kahin pehle se kaam kar raha tha: Beagle ke 5 saala safar (1831 se) se mushahidat shuru hue aur baad ke saal theory banane mein lage; Wallace ka milta julta khat 1858 mein mila (Darwin 1840s mein theory ke khaake likh chuka tha, chapter se aage).
2. 1858 mein dono theories Linnaean Society mein pesh hui to Wallace ne khud theory Darwin se mansoob karne par ittefaq kiya aur use kitab chhapne par aamada kiya.
3. Phir Darwin ne 1859 mein "On the Origin of Species" chhapi, bohat se saboot wali mukammal kitab (Galapagos finches aur kachhwe, fossils, overproduction, variation, baqa ki jang, adaptive traits ki virasat), jabke 1858 ke papers mukhtasar the.
4. Tafseeli saboot aur kitab ke wasee asar ki wajah se theory Darwin ke naam se mash'hoor hui; Wallace ko ab bhi alag se daryaft karne wala sharik mana jata hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Chapter ke box mein Wallace ke khat ka saal 1957 chhapa hai jo ghalat hai (Wallace 1913 mein faut hua); khat 1858 mein bheja gaya tha. Yeh topic lesson mein Kitab ki ghalti ke taur par darj hai.

blocks.prompt:
4. Describe and analyse examples of technology that have extended or modified the scientific understanding of evolution (e.g., the contribution of radiometric dating to the palaeontological analysis of fossils).
Aisi technology ki misaalein bayan karein aur jaaiza lein jinhon ne evolution ki scientific samajh ko barhaya ya badla (maslan fossils ke palaeontological tajziye mein radiometric dating ka hissa).
blocks.explanation:
1. Radiometric dating (chapter se aage): chattanon mein radioactive isotopes muqarrara raftar se toot-te hain (maslan uranium-lead, potassium-argon; taqreeban 50,000 saal tak ki baqiyat ke liye carbon-14). Asal aur bane isotopes naap kar chattan aur us ke fossils ki asal umar milti hai. Is se fossils ki sirf tarteeb ke bajaye tareekh wali timeline bani, maloom hua ke zameen arbon saal purani hai (aahista evolution ke liye kafi waqt), aur prokaryotes taqreeban 3.5 arab aur eukaryotes taqreeban 2 arab saal pehle jaisi tareekhon ki tasdeeq hui.
2. DNA aur protein sequencing (molecular biology, chapter mein): rishtedar jaandaron ke molecules milte julte hain; mutation ki taqreeban mustaqil raftar maan kar farq ginne se (molecular clock) nasalon ke alag hone ka waqt maloom hota hai. Is se anatomy ke saath molecular homology ka saboot mila aur kabhi sirf anatomy wale rishte durust hue.
3. Electron microscopy aur organelles ka molecular mutala: mitochondria aur chloroplasts ka apna gol DNA aur binary fission, jo endosymbiotic theory ki taeed karta hai.
4. Genetics aur population statistics: virasat ka ilm aur Hardy-Weinberg theorem (1908) se Neo-Darwinism bana; evolution = allele frequency ki tabdeeli; drift, gene flow aur mutation ki wazahat; Lamarckism radd hua.
5. Microbiology aur tibb: bacteria mein antibiotic resistance dekh kar natural selection se evolution chand saalon mein hota nazar aata hai.
Jaaiza: in technologies ne Darwin ki natural selection ko khatam nahi kiya balke alag saboot se test kiya, woh tareekhein aur mechanisms diye jo Darwin ke paas nahi the, aur tafseel badli (maslan genetic drift mein ittefaq ka kirdar).
